Application Data.NAME: AutoTech Repair Services Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: AutoTech Repair Services Inc. specializes in a wide range of automotive repair and maintenance services, including oil changes, brake repairs, and diagnostics. Our facility is equipped with state-of-the-art tools and technology to ensure efficient and high-quality service. We maintain a secure and well-organized premises compliant with OSHA regulations, with proper safety training for all employees. We do not engage in high-risk activities such as racing modifications or emergency towing, allowing us to focus on providing reliable and safe automotive services to our valued customers. Regular inspections and maintenance of our equipment further enhance safety and operational efficiency.
